draft_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training.
revised_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training.
rationale: T1.r3-r5 show Wrenfold higher than Fennick-Base on all three held-out domains. No statistical test is reported, so the hedge is appropriate.
